contractFindings.minimalGuard: Choose and bind one accepted tar profile. For these short ASCII paths, direct regular headers can avoid PAX/GNU name overrides and sparse files entirely. Explicitly refuse unsupported extended/global/longname/sparse headers and all links/devices/FIFOs; require one exact logical member set and declared order. Bound compressed input size, streaming expanded tar bytes including headers/padding, member count, names, each member size and total body bytes before allocation or exclusive write; exact body totals alone do not cap malicious metadata.
